purpose: First crane flight video test for user review; no website integration yet.

params.prompt: Animate the approved nine-crane sumi-e ink flock, each crane keeping its red ink crown, with independent naturally staggered wingbeats, different subtle cadences and occasional glides. Rear-following camera; preserve hand-painted ink texture and nine distinct birds. Locked formation framing on a completely uniform bright chroma-green background for compositing over the existing watercolor landscapes. No scenery, no new birds, no camera cuts, no morphing, no joint-rigged appearance.

user_review_required_before: integrating the test into the page
note: Green backdrop is intentional for compositing; the existing landscape artwork is retained.
